node.title: Decisión de arquitectura
node.summary: Change or preserve dependencies, applications and controls using evidence of capability and use.

relations: In the supply-chain case, process traces were interpreted as evidence for architecture decisions rather than treated as a complete portfolio answer.
El texto público no acredita que todas las cadenas dispusieran de logs completos ni que process mining midiera por sí solo todo el ahorro del programa.
Before replacing a local database, reconstruct the corrections and capabilities it supports; a cleaner ownership map is not evidence that its contribution has been replaced.
No justifica conservar todo shadow IT ni desconocer riesgos reales de la base local.
Distributed American Innovation becomes operationally intelligible when the team itself integrates field interpretation, engineering and responsibility for the receiving operation.
El relato continental sitúa una práctica; no demuestra superioridad universal de un tamaño o estructura de equipo.
The thin integration layers described here can be read through JUBAP as focused interventions that change a leverage point while retaining useful operating capability.
Es una lectura del mecanismo; no atribuye retrospectivamente el nombre JUBAP a todos los despliegues históricos.
The field series suggests treating connectivity, institutional capacity and existing fleets as integration inputs for Mobility OS rather than as exceptions to an ideal platform.
La aplicabilidad es propuesta; requiere comprobar el soporte y las obligaciones del producto en cada perfil.

The oilfield deployment illustrates the team-as-system principle: legal, plant, quality and training workstreams must become one usable operating model rather than a collection of completed deliverables.
La doctrina posterior organiza la lectura del caso; no certifica por sí sola todos los resultados históricos reportados.
Before rationalizing a portfolio, distinguish a known assessable reserve from a grounded exploration route and from a currently ineffective evaluation route.
Las letras son relativas a actor, proceso y pregunta; no son una taxonomía objetiva y universal de aplicaciones.
